items.summary: Maintain a three-site factory pipeline: complicated.work as the strongest candidate, with deadlymaracas.com and driveford.net deferred. No new build, deployment, DNS, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue admission is authorized while delivery is saturated. The single next step is to complete the existing complicated.work launch-readiness packet with dated ownership, audience and scope, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate boundaries, compliance and security evidence or explicit unknowns, rollback point, and owner launch-gate decision. Keep the site parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched until all required gates pass.
